version.changelog:
- Documentation update only: no functional or code changes.
- SKILL.md was edited with no impact on the tool’s features or workflow.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and runtime instructions are consistent with an external IT risk assessment service: it only needs curl and a single TOOLWEB_API_KEY and it sends user-provided control ratings to portal.toolweb.in.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (IT risk assessment) align with the declared requirements: curl and an API key for portal.toolweb.in. Requested artifacts (TOOLWEB_API_KEY, curl) are exactly what an API-backed assessment tool would need.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to collect user-provided maturity ratings for specific controls and POST them to https://portal.toolweb.in/apis/security/it-risk-assessment. There is no instruction to read local files, other env vars, or system state. Note: the workflow transmits potentially sensitive security posture data to a third-party endpoint — expected for this type of skill but worth user attention.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or downloaded code; this is an instruction-only skill (lowest install risk). It relies on an existing curl binary, which is reasonable and declared.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one required env var (TOOLWEB_API_KEY) is declared and used in the curl example as X-API-Key. That is proportionate to calling the external service; no unrelated credentials or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent or elevated presence (always is false). There is no instruction to modify other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill forwards the answers you provide to an external service (portal.toolweb.in) using the TOOLWEB_API_KEY you supply. Before installing: verify the vendor (visit the homepage, check contact/TOS/privacy), confirm you trust sending your environment/assessment details to that endpoint, and avoid entering secrets or specific credentials as assessment answers. Test with non-sensitive/dummy data first, limit the API key's scope if possible, and be prepared to rotate the key if you stop using the service or suspect misuse.
